name: gk-engineering
description: Project-agnostic delivery with evidence-calibrated workload and critical-path estimates, declarative target and safety profiles, audited model routing, fail-closed completion receipts, and Goal retrospectives.

interface.shortDescription: Profile-driven delivery with fail-closed evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Sizes approved work with separate cumulative Agent workload and wall-clock critical paths, evidence-backed readiness branches, G-00 re-estimation, and correlated-risk deduplication; keeps project-specific targets and safety rules in a declarative Profile; audits runtime provenance; validates immutable completion evidence; and produces an auditable Goal retrospective.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $product-to-delivery to guide this feature from discovery through approved and verified delivery.
